'''Second Platoon''' was a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] military unit deployed on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Second Battle of Coruscant]]. [[Green Squad (Second Platoon)|Green]] and [[Gold Squad (Second Platoon)|Gold squads]] were assigned to Second Platoon.
